episodes.title: The Wacom Company Was Started By a Cult | Case File #254
episodes.description: What is the Wacom Company? Well, well it's the purveyor of finer pieces of technology usually in connection with creating art. However, this seemingly innocuous company actually has a much darker origin. One that is spawned from a sprawling networks of religious cults, political power struggles, and shocking amounts of money. THis is the story of how Wacom was started…. episodes.title: Breatharians, Cult of Breathing as Food | Case File #215
episodes.description: Who are The Breatharians and why do they sound like the villains in an 80s barbarian cartoon? Because they kinda could be. While it’s a universally acknowledged truth that humans require food to live there is a very curious subset of individuals who are convinced they’ve evolved beyond such mundane necessities.
